blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) has collected P24.8 million in abatement fees from more than 1,000 micro taxpayers who sought relief under a one-time program to settle old tax cases. In a statement, the BIR said its one-time abatement program, which took effect in July, had covered P84.51 million in tax liabilities and penalties as of Sept. 18.
